dct_description_sm: A flyer describing the digitization of all issues of Makivik Magazine, Atuaqnik, Makaivik News, Taqralik. Makivik Corporation's periodicals are a unique history of the people of Nunavik recorded by themselves and for themselves. Published since 1974, they contain stories and letters from readers, local history, political stories, chronicles and even poems.
